# OXWeb Prices

> Independent AI inference price index for comparing discounted API and relay providers.

Canonical site: https://prices.oxweb.xyz/
Machine-readable prices: https://prices.oxweb.xyz/api/prices.json
Model detail pages: https://prices.oxweb.xyz/models/<canonical-model-id>

## What this product does

- Normalizes provider model names into a searchable catalogue.
- Compares published input, output and cache prices in USD per 1M tokens.
- Keeps every model's provider offers ordered by the documented price score.
- Shows a saving percentage only when the provider publishes a meaningful reference/direct price.
- Provides indexable detail pages for individual models using the same normalized dataset and ranking.
- Offers Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI model-family shortcuts without claiming relay compatibility.
- Keeps stale last-known prices visible when one provider refresh fails, but excludes them from cheapest and best-price recommendations.

## Product boundaries

OXWeb Prices is a comparison utility, not an inference gateway. It does not route model requests, hold user balances or resell tokens.

The homepage intentionally features only current high-interest models; the full collected catalogue remains searchable and is available in the JSON feed.

Coding-client shortcuts select relevant model families only. Actual client compatibility can vary by provider and must be checked with the provider before signup.
